records.publisher: National Institute of Mental Health, U.S. National Institutes of Health
records.claim_location: Page headings: “What are the warning signs of suicide?”, “What should I do if … someone is having thoughts of suicide?”, and “Does asking someone about suicide put the idea in their head?”.
records.claim_summary: Supports taking statements/warning signs seriously and asking directly about suicidal thoughts. The opened text says direct questioning does not cause or increase such thoughts. Its U.S. emergency numbers and service routes are excluded from the Nursing lesson.
records.jurisdiction_limit: U.S. public-health source. No U.S. route is presented as a Philippine referral or facility instruction.
records.currentness_limit: Page identifies a 2023 revision; recheck the current page and local pathway at independent review.

records.claim_summary: Supports a bounded general statement about early identification, assessment, management and follow-up, and population-level prevention. It does not establish a specific patient-level assessment instrument, observation category, Philippine referral sequence, or facility protocol.
records.jurisdiction_limit: Global guidance. It is not Philippine legal authority or a facility procedure.
records.currentness_limit: Page date checked as 2026-08-28; recheck before review approval.
